title: Trump has been humbled. Now what? - podcast
summary: Journalist Molly Ball reports from Washington DC after the Republicans’ resounding midterms defeat. Will the party finally distance itself from Donald Trump? And what will the…
byline: Presented by Annie Kelly with Molly Ball; produced by Guy Szafman, Alex Atack and Brian McNamara; executive producer Sami Kent

blocks.text: How will Donald Trump react to the Republicans’ midterm drubbing? And do the Democrats have a plan beyond being the anti-Trump party?

The veteran political journalist Molly Ball talks through the ramifications of a historic set of midterm results as Trump oversaw a string of losses in red states from Kansas to Texas to South Carolina.
Are we moving, asks Annie Kelly, into a post-Trump era?
